text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills edged up to 49.36 percent from 47.44 percent at the last sale on October 22, a central bank statement said on Friday.
The results of Friday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 21.83 million UAH 8.44 million UAH
Actual amount raised 17.52 million UAH 6.83 million UAH
The central bank sold 218,281 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 133,143 were competitive and 85,138 were non-competitive bids.
The next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for October 29.
The average yield at the latest auction of nine-month discount treasury bills stood at 58.20 percent, the same as at the last sale on October 22, a central bank statement said.
The results of Friday's auction, compared to the last issue of nine-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 32.810 million UAH 4.614 million UAH
Actual amount raised 22.860 million UAH 3.215 million UAH
The central bank sold 328,105 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 307,698 were competitive and 20,407 were non-competitive bids.
The next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for October 29.
The average yield at the latest auction of 12-month discount treasury bills edged down to 61.04 percent from 61.20 percent at the last sale on October 17, a central bank statement said.
The results of Friday's auction, compared to the last issue of 12-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
The central bank sold 5,729 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 3,465 were competitive and 2,264 were non-competitive bids.
The next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for October 29.
